title: Digital Content Creator (Automotive Dealership)
industry: IT, Media, Advertising, Arts and Entertainment
description:
Job Title
:               Digital Content Creator (Automotive Dealership)
Company Name:
Boroko Motors
Location:
Port Moresby
Overview:
We are looking for a creative and motivated
Digital Content Creator
to join our dealership team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for creating high-quality photos, videos, and social media content that showcases our vehicles, dealership activities and customer experiences.
This role combines photography, video editing and social media management to help promote the dealership’s brand and drive engagement across digital platforms.
Key Responsibilities:
Capture professional-quality photos and videos of vehicles, dealership events and customer deliveries.
Edit and enhance images using
Adobe Photoshop
,
Lightroom
, or similar software.
Create short-form video content (e.g., reels, TikToks, YouTube shorts) for marketing and promotions.
Manage and update dealership social media pages (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, etc.).
Plan and schedule social media posts according to marketing campaigns.
Collaborate with sales and management teams to promote key models, offers, and events.
Maintain consistent branding and visual identity across all digital platforms.
Monitor social media engagement and respond to comments and messages in a professional manner.
Minimum Requirements:
Relevant qualification or proven experience in
photography
,
digital media
, or
marketing
.
Strong skills in
Adobe Photoshop
,
Lightroom
,
Canva
, and basic
video editing
(Premiere Pro, CapCut, etc.).
Experience managing social media pages for a business or brand.
Good eye for composition, lighting and detail.
Strong communication and teamwork skills.
Valid driver’s license (advantageous for photographing test drives and deliveries).
Passion for the
automotive industry
and creative storytelling.
Preferred Attributes:
Experience working in a
car dealership
or
automotive environment
.
Knowledge of social media advertising and analytics.
Basic understanding of SEO and online marketing trends.
Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
How to Apply:
If you're excited to join a dynamic team and make a real impact, we'd love to hear from you!
Please submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your experience and why you'd be a great fit for this role to
[email protected]
or by clicking
Apply
below.
